table.name: Breeds
table.purpose: Lookup table of dog breeds with a short code and a full breed name; referenced by the Dogs table.

col_001.name: breed_code
col_001.description: Primary key. Short three-letter breed code (e.g. ESK = Eskimo, HUS = Husky, BUL = Bulldog). Referenced by Dogs.col_004.

col_002.name: breed_name
col_002.description: Full breed name corresponding to the code (Eskimo, Husky, Bulldog).

table.name: Charges
table.purpose: A small lookup/price list of veterinary service charge types (e.g. daily accommodation, drugs, health check) with an associated unit price/fee per charge type. Likely used to price treatments in the Treatments/Treatment_Types context of a veterinary clinic database.

col_001.name: charge_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique identifier for each charge type row.

col_002.name: charge_type
col_002.description: Name/description of the charge type (e.g. 'Daily Accommodation', 'Drugs', 'Health Check').

col_003.name: price
col_003.description: Fee/price for the charge type, in unspecified currency units (values 98, 322, 640).

table.name: Dogs
table.purpose: Registry of dogs (patients) in a veterinary clinic database, each row one dog with its breed, size, owner, age, weight and various status/booking timestamps. Referenced by Treatments.

col_001.name: dog_id
col_001.description: Primary key identifying each dog; referenced by Treatments.

col_002.name: owner_id
col_002.description: Reference to Owners.col_001; the dog's owner (lookup shows owner names like Melisa, Tre, Rachelle).

col_004.name: breed_code
col_004.description: Reference to Breeds.col_001; three-letter breed code (ESK=Eskimo, HUS=Husky, BUL=Bulldog).

col_005.name: size_code
col_005.description: Reference to Sizes.col_001; size category code (SML=Small, MED=Medium, LGE=Large).

col_006.name: name
col_006.description: The dog's name; unique per row, human first names.

col_007.name: age
col_007.description: Small integer 1-9, most plausibly the dog's age in years; could also be a rating or count, but age fits a dog registry best.

col_008.name: date_of_birth
col_008.description: Timestamp 2008-2018, unique per row; most plausibly the dog's birth date (recorded as timestamp). Could alternatively be a registration date.

col_010.name: weight
col_010.description: Decimal 1.39-9.8, unique per row; plausibly the dog's weight (units unclear, likely kg).

table.name: Owners
table.purpose: Pet owners registered at a veterinary clinic; each row is one dog owner with contact details. Referenced by Dogs and Treatments.

col_001.name: owner_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique owner identifier, integer 1-15.

col_004.name: street_address
col_004.description: Street address including house number, street name, and unit/suite.

col_006.name: state
col_006.description: US state of residence, stored without spaces (e.g. 'NorthDakota', 'NewYork').

col_007.name: zip_code
col_007.description: US ZIP code, stored as zero-padded 5-character string (e.g. '00589').

col_009.name: primary_phone
col_009.description: Owner's primary phone number (various formats, some with extensions).

col_010.name: secondary_phone
col_010.description: Owner's second phone number (various formats, some with extensions); distinct from col_009 but which is primary vs. secondary is not determinable.

table.name: Professionals
table.purpose: Staff directory of a veterinary clinic: veterinarians and other employees, with contact and address details. Referenced by Treatments (which professional performed/assisted a treatment).

col_001.name: professional_id
col_001.description: Primary key, unique integer identifying each professional (veterinarian or employee).

col_002.name: role
col_002.description: Job category of the person: 'Veterenarian' (sic, misspelled Veterinarian) or 'Employee'.

col_004.name: street_address
col_004.description: Full street address including street line, city, state and ZIP (multi-line).

col_005.name: city
col_005.description: City of residence (also appears embedded in col_004).

col_006.name: state
col_006.description: US state of residence; some values written without spaces (e.g. 'NorthCarolina').

col_007.name: zip_code
col_007.description: US ZIP code stored as zero-padded text (e.g. '02281').

col_010.name: phone
col_010.description: Primary phone number (various formats, some with extensions).

col_011.name: secondary_phone
col_011.description: A second phone number for the professional; distinct from col_010 in every row, so likely an alternate/secondary phone. Could also be a fax number, but nothing distinguishes it.

table.name: Sizes
table.purpose: Lookup table of dog size categories (Small, Medium, Large), referenced by the Dogs table to classify dogs by size.

col_001.name: size_code
col_001.description: Primary key. Three-letter code for the dog size category: SML = Small, MED = Medium, LGE = Large. Referenced by Dogs.col_005.

col_002.name: size_name
col_002.description: Human-readable label for the size category: Small, Medium, Large.

table.name: Treatment_Types
table.purpose: Lookup table of treatment/service types offered (e.g., examination, vaccination, dog walking) referenced by the Treatments table in a dog-related (veterinary/pet care) database.

col_001.name: treatment_type_code
col_001.description: Short code identifying the treatment type (EXAM = examination, VAC = vaccination, WALK = walk). Primary key, referenced by Treatments.col_004.

col_002.name: treatment_type_name
col_002.description: Human-readable label of the treatment type matching the code in col_001.

table.name: Treatments
table.purpose: One row per treatment/service event performed on a dog: which dog, which professional, what type of treatment, when, and an associated amount or charge value.

col_001.name: treatment_id
col_001.description: Primary key of the Treatments table; unique surrogate identifier for each treatment record.

col_002.name: dog_id
col_002.description: Foreign key to Dogs (Dogs.col_001), identifying the dog that received the treatment. The column also statistically matches Owners and Professionals ids because those tables share the same id range, but the dog reading is the natural one for a treatment record.

col_003.name: professional_id
col_003.description: Foreign key to Professionals (Professionals.col_001), identifying the professional (veterinarian or employee) who performed the treatment. It also matches Dogs ids statistically, but the professional reading fits a treatment record; the join was only accepted by the LLM, so some uncertainty remains.

col_004.name: treatment_type_code
col_004.description: Foreign key to Treatment_Types.col_001; code for the type of treatment: EXAM = Physical examination, VAC = Vaccination, WALK = Take for a Walk.

col_005.name: treatment_date
col_005.description: Timestamp of when the treatment took place (all events fall between 2018-02-26 and 2018-03-24).
